answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1294 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the haven. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the beacon queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. The nadir index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Honest users pay that once, farms 39 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
